query_normalized: predicting chemical reaction yields from spectroscopic data with attention mechanisms chemistry
rationale: The paper focuses on the theoretical limitations and improvement of evidential deep learning for uncertainty quantification in general datasets, without addressing the specific domain of chemical reaction yields, spectroscopic data, or the application of attention mechanisms for yield prediction. It fails to meet any inclusion criteria (a-f) as it does not study the relevant biological/chemical mechanism, variables, or empirical population, nor does it provide a foundational method specifically
